description: This file defines the `OFBizTestCase` class, which extends `EntityTestCase` and provides testing utilities for OFBiz components. It includes methods for retrieving user logins, managing a local dispatcher, and conducting entity queries, primarily for testing purposes within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OFBizTestCase
classes.description: A test case class extending `EntityTestCase` that provides utility methods for functional testing within the OFBiz framework, including entity retrieval and dispatcher management.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the current LocalDispatcher instance used in the test case.

methods.name: setDispatcher
methods.description: Sets the LocalDispatcher instance for the test case.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the `GenericValue` for a user login by userLoginId; defaults to 'system'.
